name: A Ship of Your Own
intro: A rowboat's a fine thing for a bay. For the open sea you want a cog: sixteen packs in her hold and a square sail. I'll sell you the design - ten silver and six Charter Seals - and you build her on the slipway beside my shed. Lumber bundles from Hob, iron crates from Brenna, sailcloth from flax at the Lanternwick bench.

steps.text: Lay a Merchant Cog Design on the Lanternwick slipway
Build all four stages of the cog

outro: Look at her sit in the water! Fill that hold, mind the wind, and Gullrock will make you rich.
